about.title: Engineering with clarity, scale, and care.
paragraphs: I'm a backend-focused full-stack developer specializing in Java and Spring Boot, with additional experience in Node.js/Express for backend work and Flutter for cross-platform mobile apps. I care about clear domain models, dependable APIs, and code the next engineer won't have to fight with.

At Ashara Software and ICT Solutions, I've built and shipped two systems currently in production use: Mesob Equb, a digital rotating-savings platform, and Ashara Task Manager, the company's internal workflow tool.

projects.title: Selected work, built end to end.
projects.description: A mix of production systems, SaaS platforms, and personal builds — each focused on solving a real problem end to end.

items.title: Mesob Equb
items.summary: A digital rotating savings and credit association (equb) platform modernizing traditional group-savings workflows.
items.role: Mobile developer, Ashara Software and ICT Solutions
highlights: Telebirr payment integration with staff-verified receipts
Automated payout tracking and member contribution schedules
Live lottery-style draws with SMS notifications in 4 languages
Live in production with 105+ rounds completed to date

items.title: Ashara Task Manager
items.summary: A collaborative task management and team operations platform built for structured company workflows.
items.role: Full-stack developer, Ashara Software and ICT Solutions
highlights: Real-time task tracking, state management, and team assignment dashboards
Role-based access control for administrative oversight
In active daily use across the team

items.title: MaSchool
items.summary: An education platform for Ethiopian students, built around exam simulations and structured study content.
highlights: Cross-platform Flutter app used by students preparing for national exams
Content pipeline for structured exam simulations and study material
Designed for low-bandwidth, multi-device access

items.title: Ma'ed Platform
items.summary: A multi-café SaaS ordering platform connecting physical café tables to digital menus through QR codes, with a PWA-first customer experience and built-in QR scanning.
highlights: Unique table QR codes automatically identify the café and table and open the correct digital menu
First-time customers can enter through any phone QR scanner, then optionally install the Ma'ed PWA from the menu
Installed users can scan new café table QR codes directly inside Ma'ed and switch café/table sessions
Café dashboard for tables, menus, orders, staff operations, analytics, trials, and subscriptions
Initial go-to-market target of 205 cafés across Addis Ababa, Adama, Hawassa, and Bedele with a one-month free trial

items.title: Yashenifu
items.summary: A mobile application delivering structured promotional draws, lucky-card UI, and user engagement features.
highlights: Custom UI components for draw lists and interactive reward cards
Smooth layout transitions tuned for mobile displays
Integrated backend endpoints for verified user participation

items.title: Mistir — File Encryption
items.summary: A file encryption tool built with usability for non-technical users as the priority.
highlights: AES-256 based file encryption for protecting sensitive data
File compression before encryption to reduce storage footprint
MySQL integration for configuration and metadata management

items.title: FiraSec
items.summary: A security diagnostic tool designed for multi-platform device management and system identification.
highlights: Low-level hardware queries using specialized host libraries
Responsive workstation interface for system diagnostic monitoring
Device info extraction across connected mobile clients

items.title: Odaa Password Manager
items.summary: A privacy-focused password manager for secure offline credential storage and generation.
highlights: Zero-knowledge architecture with client-side master-key derivation
Local encrypted vault storage using AES
Built-in password strength analyzer and secure random generator

items.title: Blaze Bingo
items.summary: A scalable bingo platform designed for bingo houses and players, covering game management, card generation, real-time gameplay, and result processing.
highlights: Bingo house and player workflows with role-aware game management
Real-time Bingo 75 gameplay and automated card/result processing
Node.js, TypeScript, Express, Prisma, PostgreSQL, React, and Flutter-based components
Designed with high-concurrency operation and fast game-result processing in mind

items.title: FancyChiwata
items.summary: A fantasy football platform where users compete based on their team-selection and management performance, with winning outcomes determined by fantasy performance.
highlights: Fantasy Premier League-style team selection and management experience
Performance-based scoring and ranking system
Designed around competitive leagues, player performance, and transparent results
Built to make fantasy football competition simple and engaging

items.title: ETHSL
items.summary: A digital platform project focused on delivering structured services and workflows for an Ethiopian user base.
highlights: Designed as a structured digital service platform
Backend-driven workflows and API integration
Responsive web experience for accessible multi-device use

items.title: Lehulum SMS
items.summary: An SMS-focused platform for managing messaging workflows, recipients, and communication services.
highlights: Centralized SMS communication workflows
Recipient and message management
Backend-oriented architecture for reliable messaging integration
Designed for organizations that need structured outbound communication

items.title: Check Payment
items.summary: A payment verification platform concept designed to simplify checking and validating payment transactions across Ethiopian payment methods.
highlights: Designed around payment verification and transaction-status checking
Architecture intended to support multiple Ethiopian banks and payment providers
Provider integrations isolated behind a unified verification layer
Focus on secure transaction verification and simple API integration
